Delivery Senior Software Engineer July 2025 – Present
Mphasis India Pvt. Ltd. Bangalore, Karnataka, India
Account Inquiry Microservice | Java, Spring Boot, GraphQL, Splunk December 2025 – March 2026
• Developed high-throughput service handling 1M+ daily account inquiries using multi-threading, elevating throughput by 45% and
achieving sub-200ms response times.
• Integrated GraphQL APIs and thread-safe caching, lowering database load by 60% and reducing query execution from 500ms to
• Deployed centralized logging and monitoring across 5 environments, shortening incident resolution time by 30% and enabling
99.95% uptime.
Funds Transfer Service | Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, MongoDB July 2025 – December 2025
• Built mission-critical banking service processing 500K+ daily transfers with 99.99% availability and $2B+ monthly transaction
volume.
• Orchestrated multiple external banking APIs, decreasing reconciliation failures by 45% and reducing settlement time from 4
hours to 30 minutes.
Healthcare Analytics Platform | Java, Spring Boot, MapReduce, AWS January 2022 – December 2024
• Streamlined analytics pipelines processing 10TB+ healthcare datasets daily, compressing execution time by 30% and handling
5M+ patient records.
• Strengthened system reliability through fault-tolerant service design and monitoring, achieving 99.8% uptime across 3 data
centers.
QR-Based Payment System (Visa & MasterCard) | Java, Spring Boot, AWS January 2021 – December 2022
• Structured secure QR payment platform for real-time merchant transactions at BRAC Bank, processing 250K+ daily transactions
worth $5M+.
• Pioneered end-to-end encryption framework leveraging RSA-SHA256 cryptographic protocols and Visa/MasterCard MLE
specifications, fortifying regulatory adherence across payment infrastructure.
• Amplified transaction throughput by 40% while mitigating fraud risk, reducing fraudulent transactions by 65%.
